why1.why: Drone-style view of the headland with the lighthouse on top and the sea and beach beyond; shows the cape setting. Lens saw only the thumbnail, licence not read.
Lighthouse from the steps with walkers and blue sky, 2011; ground-level, shows the lighthouse itself.
Tilted lighthouse against blue sky, 2013; tilt is a drawback.

why2.why: Wategos at sunrise with the headland and light on the wet sand; different from spot file 02. Licence assumed same as 02, verify.
2025 aerial-style panorama of Wategos and the headland, aspect 2.5 (wide); fine for a why card, not a header.
